_comment: Routines shown in the ROUTINES panel and the Timeline. `windows`: Windows Task Scheduler tasks by name; state comes from Task Scheduler (routines.ps1), runs per day from `log` when it has timestamped lines (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS ...), else from the scheduler's last run. `claude`: Claude Code scheduled tasks; copy the cron here; runs come from the vault Run Log named in `runlog` (lines `- YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM — outcome`) and, when activityDir is set, from the hook log. `apps`: nodes on the map's outer ring; a project or area note links to one when its body matches `match`. `owner` ties a routine to a project or area note.
